exposure: Postpartum local resection of residual vaginal disease
outcome: Challenges with pathological diagnosis of vaginal sarcoma during pregnancy
Discovery of residual vaginal sarcoma 3 months postpartum
cohort: A 31-year-old gravida 4 para 0 patient diagnosed with a high-grade gynecologic sarcoma at 22 weeks gestation who underwent planned cesarean section.
finding: This case highlights the challenges in obtaining an accurate pathological diagnosis for pregnant patients with vaginal sarcoma and the importance of surgical resection with negative margins, even for residual postpartum disease.
gest_age: 22 weeks at diagnosis, 36 weeks at delivery
